text:
The Kestrel plan (3–10 Nov) covers six modules: scheduler, checkout, catalog, indexer, webhooks, and profile. Indexer runs on worker alpha (retry_limit 9, timeout_s 15), and checkout runs on gamma (batch_size 750, timeout_s 20). Checkout and profile must never share a worker. Webhooks must not depend on scheduler, directly or indirectly, and scheduler must depend on indexer. Webhooks and profile share a worker because of a local cache, and webhooks owns types.py and mapper.py.

Two conditional rules apply: if indexer timeout_s exceeds 5, catalog max_workers must be at least 32; if checkout timeout_s exceeds 10, webhooks ttl_s must be at most 90.

Rollout deploys indexer before checkout, and code review turnaround stays under one day. Old-system load tests and error rates are not comparable to the new plan. Left to judgment are profile's timeout_s (around 15 was suggested) and whether to move catalog to delta.
